pages.editorialChoice: Coda ambiental ilustrada; las acciones se narran fuera de encuadre y se conservan los diálogos del cierre.
pages.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE finished 1024x1536 portrait comic page as an ENVIRONMENTAL CODA: a sequence of atmospheric still-life and architecture panels, with the story told by Spanish caption boxes. Warm richly colored hand-inked storybook cartoon painting, soft golden autumn morning light, detailed wood and stone, cream gutters, crisp black panel frames. Small header exactly 'Capítulo 4 · 23'. Six panels in Western reading order. NO HUMAN FIGURES, no portraits, no faces, no silhouettes: the subjects are the dining hall, benches, tableware, parchment, a backpack and a muffin. This is a quiet closing sequence after a school breakfast, never a placeholder or a text-only page. Each panel has a fully realized scenic illustration.
Setting continuity: grand medieval stone dining hall with tall arched leaded-glass windows, enchanted floating candles and long polished wooden tables. One table has deep GREEN and SILVER banners; across a wide aisle another table has BURGUNDY and GOLD banners. A small oatmeal bowl, fruit, a muffin and a quill with parchment belong to breakfast. Keep the two tables visually distinct. All narration is cream rectangular caption boxes, printed legibly in large accented Spanish letters. Print ONLY the exact caption text below; no other words or decorative pseudo-writing.
Panel1, wide warm view of the GREEN-banner table end, a quill, parchment and breakfast dishes in the foreground. Caption exactly: 'Daphne: «Cuando quieras, Hermione.»'
Panel2, long view down the sunlit aisle toward the separate BURGUNDY-banner table. Caption exactly: 'Hermione regresó a Gryffindor y se sentó junto a Ginny.'
Panel3, intimate still-life of ONE muffin on a small plate at the burgundy table, a brown backpack resting on the adjacent bench, empty chair backs, sunbeams. Caption exactly: 'Desde Slytherin, Pansy se permitió una pequeña sonrisa.'
Panel4, close view of morning light on the GREEN-banner table, parchment and a cup. Caption exactly: 'Pansy: «¿Qué?»'
Panel5, view of floating candles and the green/silver banner above the tabletop. Caption exactly: 'Daphne: «Nada. Solo admito que McGonagall es realmente brillante.»'
Panel6, large panoramic closing view of the beautiful dining hall architecture, tall bright windows, the two long tables on opposite sides and golden light. Caption exactly: 'Fin del capítulo 4'.
No identifiable people or any character depiction. Use scenic storytelling with the exact captions to convey the farewell and the offscreen conversation.
